verdict.rationale: Glama Chat lets users upload their own documents and get AI-generated answers with exact page references, so the product itself provides AI responses grounded in user data. That is user-initiated Q&A, not proactive insights or suggestions derived from the user's data (e.g., gateway logs or usage), and it rests on a single thin marketing line. Missing for 10: proactive AI insights or suggestions over account and usage data, documentation of analysis depth beyond document Q&A, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
